title: ROOMGUIState
description: Body of the ROOMGUI full-state send -- the server-wide room/lobby roster, broadcast to every connected player after any roommanager/room-namespace action (see .claude/server_game_interface_spec.md).

gameName.description: Empty string if no game is currently attached to this room.

isDone.description: True if this room has no game, or its game has finished.

gameTypes.description: Game types startable in this room; always empty for the Great Hall.

inhabitants.description: Names of the players currently in this specific room. Nested per-room rather than a single server-wide list, since the room-navigation client widget is the only consumer of this information anywhere in the client, and it only ever cares about one room's roster at a time.

myroom.description: Per-viewer convenience field: an exact duplicate of whichever 'rooms' entry the recipient currently occupies -- lets the client find its own room without searching the 'rooms' array by name. Null only if the recipient somehow isn't in any room, which shouldn't happen in practice: every connection is placed in a room (the Great Hall by default) as soon as it logs in.
